title: It Had to Be You

evidence.note: Wikipedia states the song 'was published on May 9, 1924 by Jerome H. Remick & Co. of New York.'
IMSLP's catalog entry for the sheet music lists the publisher info as 'New York: Jerome H. Remick & Co., 1924', confirming 1924 publication.
